headline: ISS AND GLASS LEWIS BOTH BACK EQUINOX-ORLA DEAL — All Major Proxy Advisors Greenlight Creation of 1.1M oz Canadian Gold Giant; July 22 Vote Now a Formality (TSX:EQX / TSX:ORLA)
snippet: Every major independent proxy advisory firm — including Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) and Glass Lewis — has issued favourable voting recommendations ahead of Equinox Gold's July 22 special shareholder meeting to approve the share issuance required to complete its acquisition of Orla Mining, clearing the final substantive hurdle before a deal expected to close in Q3 2026. The combined company would produce approximately 1.1 million gold-equivalent ounces per year from six mines across the US, Mexico, and Nicaragua, with a growth pipeline targeting 1.9 million ounces annually — making it the second-largest gold producer in Canada with Pierre Lassonde among the backers; former Orla shareholders are expected to hold approximately 33% of the merged entity.

headline: FRONTIER NUCLEAR DEPLOYS 120 HOLES AND 36,000m AT PINE RIDGE — Wyoming Uranium Campaign Eyes 2027 Maiden Resource Estimate 15km from Cameco's Licensed 5.5M lb/yr Processing Plant (NASDAQ:FNUC)
snippet: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. (NASDAQ: FNUC) launched on July 14 its 2026 drill program at the 100%-owned Pine Ridge uranium project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin — approximately 120 holes totalling 36,000 metres, running one rig from July through December with a potential January 2027 extension. The campaign builds on a 2025 program that confirmed widespread mineralization continuity across multiple areas and identified at least 25 mineralized roll fronts; Pine Ridge covers 39,390 acres positioned approximately 15 kilometres from Cameco's Smith Ranch processing facility, which carries a licensed production capacity of 5.5 million pounds of U₃O₈ per annum — providing a clear toll-milling path if drilling delivers a maiden resource by the targeted early-2027 timeline.

headline: ZODIAC GOLD'S ARTHINGTON FIRES UP NEW DRILL — 37 of 39 Historical Holes Hit Gold Up to 55.9 g/t; New 3,000-5,000m Campaign Launches Along 16km Liberia Gold Trend (TSXV:ZAU)
snippet: Zodiac Gold Inc. (TSXV: ZAU) commenced on July 14 a new diamond drill program of between 3,000 and 5,000 metres at its Arthington discovery on the Todi Gold Project in Liberia, with scope to add a second rig in Q4 2026 depending on results. The program builds on an exceptional 37-for-39 historic hole success rate at Arthington — including high-grade intervals reaching 55.9 g/t Au — with drilling designed to extend the deposit at depth and along strike within the district-scale 16-kilometre Monterra Trend, while tightening drill density ahead of a planned maiden NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate.

headline: ALMONTY'S SANGDONG TUNGSTEN DEAL BALLOONS TO $490M — 21-Year Offtake with Global Tungsten & Powders Adds 40% Volume and 6.3% Better Pricing as South Korea Processing Plant Ramps (NASDAQ:ALM)
snippet: Almonty Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: ALM / TSX: AII) announced July 14 an amendment to its long-term offtake agreement with Global Tungsten & Powders LLC (Plansee Group) covering tungsten concentrate from Phase I of the Sangdong Mine in South Korea — extending the term from 15 to 21 years (into the late 2040s), increasing contracted volumes by 40%, and improving pricing by approximately 6.3%, lifting total contracted revenue to US$490 million at current prices. The expansion follows Almonty's July 1 announcement that processing operations had commenced at Sangdong; the agreement covers approximately 90% of Phase I production, providing Almonty with one of the most fully contracted critical-mineral production profiles of any Western junior with a mine in ramp-up.

headline: KUTCHO'S FIRST NEW-TARGET DRILL IN 15+ YEARS GETS UNDERWAY — 2 Rigs Attack Hamburger, Gap, and Esso West ZTEM Anomalies at Feasibility-Stage Cu-Zn Project, NW British Columbia (TSXV:KC)
snippet: Kutcho Copper Corp. (TSXV: KC) commenced on July 14 its 2026 drill program at its feasibility-stage copper-zinc project in Northwest British Columbia — the first comprehensive exploration campaign testing multiple new targets at Kutcho in more than 15 years. Two diamond drill rigs are executing 11 planned holes across the Hamburger, Gap, and Esso West targets, each an untested ZTEM conductivity high proximal to the known resource base along a prospective time horizon extending over 12 kilometres along strike; all holes will be accompanied by down-hole EM surveys to guide resource extension work alongside a concurrent feasibility study.

headline: MEXICO GREENLIGHT: SIERRA MADRE GETS SEMARNAT PERMIT FOR 30,000m AT GUITARRA — 22 Drill Pads Cover 30 Vein Systems as Silver-Gold East District Opens Up for First Time (TSXV:SM)
source_name: GlobeNewsWire / Sierra Madre Gold and Silver Ltd.
snippet: Sierra Madre Gold and Silver Ltd. (TSXV: SM) announced July 14 that it has received SEMARNAT approval for drilling across 22 drill pads in the East District of the Guitarra Mine silver-gold complex in Mexico's Temascaltepec mining district, enabling Phase 1 of a fully budgeted 30,000-metre program that will test up to 30 distinct mapped vein systems — the first systematic exploration drilling the Guitarra East District has ever received. Sierra Madre restarted commercial production at the Guitarra mine's 500-tpd processing facility in January 2025; the East District permit unlocks what management has characterised as the property's largest unexplored vein corridor, with drill contractor bids now being received.

headline: WALLBRIDGE MARTINIERE PHASE 1 ENDS STRONG — Bug Lake Corridor Returns 4.34 g/t Over 10m and 2.63 g/t Over 9.8m; Footprint Grows to 2,000m Strike in James Bay Quebec (TSX:WM)
snippet: Wallbridge Mining Company Limited (TSX: WM) reported July 14 assay results from the final four holes of Phase 1 at its Martinière gold project, 30 km west of Fenelon and 45 km east of Agnico Eagle's Detour Lake mine — highlights from the Bug Lake deformation corridor include 4.34 g/t Au over 10.0 metres and 2.63 g/t Au over 9.8 metres, with all six Phase 1 holes intersecting multiple gold-bearing shear structures, including a high-grade core of 36.10 g/t over 0.5 metres. The results extend Martinière's mineralized footprint to at least 2,000 metres along strike, 800 metres wide, and 800 metres deep; the combined resource stands at 346,000 oz Indicated and 387,000 oz Inferred, remaining open in multiple directions as Phase 2 planning continues following temporary delays from regional wildfire conditions.

headline: PROSPECT RIDGE'S FIRST DRILL EVER TURNS ON EXCALIBUR — Never-Tested 1km×2km Cu-Au Porphyry Anomaly in BC's Historic Babine Belt Finally Getting Its Answer (CSE:PRR)
snippet: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp. (CSE: PRR) commenced July 12 maiden diamond drilling at the Excalibur copper-gold porphyry project on a 28 km² road-accessible tenure in British Columbia's Babine porphyry belt — a 1 km × 2 km geophysical and geochemical anomaly that has never previously been drilled, positioned near the former Huckleberry, Bell, and Granisle copper-gold mines. An initial 1,500-metre program is targeting three to four collar locations across the key anomaly, with a further 1,500 metres of success-contingent drilling available to deploy in 2026; the program follows a multi-year area-based drill permit received in July 2026.

headline: 'SILVER RETURNS TO TRIPLE DIGITS BEFORE YEAR-END': ED STEER CALLS CORRECTION TERMINAL — Cites 6 Consecutive Annual Supply Deficits and Asian Sessions Absorbing Western Selling as Structural Floor
snippet: Veteran precious metals analyst Ed Steer, in a July 13 interview with Money Metals Exchange published on GoldSeek, argues that gold and silver's 2026 correction is at its terminal phase — citing six consecutive years of structural silver supply deficit (annual consumption exceeding mine production every year since 2020), and the striking asymmetry that gold gained 12.9% in Asian trading sessions through H1 2026 while declining over 15% during North American hours, signalling that Western institutional selling rather than fundamental deterioration drove the pullback. Steer forecasts silver returning to triple-digit prices before year-end 2026 as the seasonally normal H2 rally unfolds, and calls the July-August window the final re-entry point before the autumn advance closes.

headline: MINING AMERICAS RAMPS PAN TO 80,000 t/d WITH NEW CONTRACTOR — Nevada Heap-Leach Delivers 8,137 oz In Q2, H2 Rate Increase Locks In 32-38K oz Full-Year Target (TSX:MAI)
snippet: Mining Americas Inc. (TSX: MAI) reported July 14 that its Pan gold mine in White Pine County, Nevada produced 8,137 ounces in Q2 2026, bringing year-to-date output to 16,871 ounces as the mine reached budget following the introduction of a new mining contractor at the start of the year. Mining rates at Pan have successfully ramped to over 80,000 tonnes per day — up significantly from the 55,000 tonnes per day previously achieved — with the improved throughput underpinning management's confidence in a higher-production H2 and full-year guidance of 32,000 to 38,000 ounces at all-in sustaining costs of US$1,850 to US$2,000 per ounce.
